name: thinking-orb
title: Thinking orb
author: Jakub Antalik (libraries.dev/orbs), made with help from Alexandr Brinza. MIT, from the thinking-orbs package.
description: Dotted thought-orb loader by Jakub Antalik: nine animated states (working, searching, solving, listening, connecting, weaving, composing, breathing, shaping), sizes 64, 32 and 20, light and dark ink, on a plain 2D canvas. <ThinkingOrb state="searching" size={64} />
